dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agency personnel, researchers, and scientific or coastal communities in specific states.
dimensions.evidence: robust stakeholder engagement from the scientific and coastal communities

dimensions.assessment: Halts the planned removal of in-water infrastructure in designated arrays until a review is completed.
dimensions.evidence: prohibits the National Science Foundation from using Federal funds to descope or decommission the Ocean Observatories Initiative instruments

dimensions.assessment: Directs existing federal funds to be used for maintenance rather than decommissioning, without new appropriations stated.
dimensions.evidence: the National Science Foundation shall not use any Federal funds to decommission or descope

dimensions.assessment: Applies a narrow statutory restriction to a specific scientific program and designated regional assets.
dimensions.evidence: Ocean Observatories Initiative instruments anchored off the States of Oregon, Washington, Alaska, and North Carolina, and in the Irminger Sea

dimensions.assessment: Effects last until the completion of a thorough review of the initiative by the National Science Foundation.
dimensions.evidence: until the National Science Foundation conducts a thorough review of the initiative

missing_information: Specific cost estimates for maintaining operations versus decommissioning
Timeline for the completion of the required review
importance_detail.rationale: The bill places a temporary funding restriction on the National Science Foundation regarding specific ocean observation instruments in designated regions until a review is finished.
